description: Golden fixture for Bedrock Edition 1.21 (M5 Bedrock track). Reference values are ALGORITHM-DERIVED by the pure-Dart BedrockBackend placement math driven by the Bedrock VersionStrategy, which seeds the web-safe MT19937 BedrockRandom (32-bit masked) rather than the Java 48-bit LCG. The Bedrock placement constants (region seed mixing, per-structure salts, ore loops) are NOT published the way Java's data-driven StructureSets are, so these values are deterministic and self-consistent but NOT externally verified; the Bedrock version is registered Supported-but-NOT-Verified so Accurate still degrades to Simulated per Req 5.2 until an authoritative Bedrock reference confirms the constants. An unregistered Bedrock version (any id other than bedrock-1.21) has no strategy and degrades with FallbackReason.bedrockNoStrategy (Req 11.3).
